notes: kb/Work PB5425 LANDED: the static size of a reference modification with no length (W3 (2:)) and of a function-identifier whose definition fixes its length (UPPER-CASE's argument-1 length, CHAR's 1, CURRENT-DATE's and WHEN-COMPILED's 21: IntrinsicSig.Length) is now read by IntrinsicBinder.KnownWidth, the one size reader InspectOperandSize asks, so a mis-sized REPLACING pair is refused COBOL0846 at --std 85. The row's earlier reading: §1985:VI.6.18.3 SR7: 'The size of literal-3 or the data item referenced by identifier-5 must be equal to the size of literal-1 or the data item referenced by identifier-3', a figurative literal-3 taking literal-1's size. BindPhraseOperands calls CheckInspectLiteralSizes for every REPLACING pair (formats 2 and 3); below 2002 InspectSizeRulesCoverDataItems makes InspectOperandSize ask a data item's static size of KnownWidth, a figurative pattern is one character (SR3) and a figurative replacement is exempt, so COBOL0846 covers literals, figuratives, plain and subscripted identifiers and a reference modification with a literal length. KnownWidth answers null for an omitted-length reference modification and for any function-identifier, so those sizes, static here, are never asked. Probes at 85: (b/d) 'AB' BY 'X', SPACE BY 'XY', WS-2 BY WS-3, the second pair of one ALL clause, a second FIRST clause, WS-3(3:1), 'A' BY a SIGN SEPARATE S9 item (size 2) and a format-3 pair are COBOL0846; ZERO as literal-3 runs; ALL 'Z' is COBOL1757; 'ABC' BY a 9.9 edited item runs ('1.5D1.5D'). (a) an ODO group as identifier-1 and an ODO element as identifier-3 run right. (f) TE(N) with N tallied by the same statement is evaluated once. (c) TRAILING is COBOL2269, N'..' COBOL0900; at --std 2002 WS-2 BY WS-3 compiles. Under-rejects: 'AB' BY WS-3(3:) (size 1), 'A' BY WS-3(2:) (size 2), 'AB' BY FUNCTION UPPER-CASE(WS-1) and ALL FUNCTION UPPER-CASE(WS-3) BY 'XY' compile and silently replace nothing. The witness's WS-F (2) BY WS-T1 (1) is COBOL0846. kb/Work PB5425 holds the defect (code read: coderead-85/out-read3/rd-04.json).

next.reason: 1985: "The size of literal-3 or the data item referenced by identifier-5 must be equal to the size of literal-1 or ... identifier-3."; 2023: "If these sizes are not equal, the EC-RANGE-INSPECT-SIZE exception condition is set to exist and the results ... are undefined.". 1985 makes equal size a syntax rule for literals and data items alike. 2023 keeps a syntax rule only for literals; for data items it sets a runtime exception with undefined results.
